nav_logo_home.source: EEG Layout Lab · 返回工作区
nav_logo_home.en: EEG Layout Lab · Back to the workspace

home_search_text.source: 选择部位、区域数和每区半径，搜索64电极布局。
home_search_text.en: Choose sites, the number of regions and the radius per region, and search for a 64-electrode layout.

home_import_text.source: 读取已有电极坐标文件，在当前条件下评价。
home_import_text.en: Read an existing electrode coordinate file and evaluate it under the current conditions.

home_copy_text.source: 从布局列表打开一个布局，移动或停用电极。
home_copy_text.en: Open a layout from the layout list and move or disable electrodes.

home_intro.source: 最近的布局、计算任务、研究和项目。新布局从这里开始；已发表的研究结果在“研究结果”中。
home_intro.en: Recent layouts, computation tasks, studies and projects. New layouts start here; published results are under “Findings”.

home_projects_text.source: 项目把多个布局、对比和交付包放在一起，便于导出和交给合作者。
home_projects_text.en: A project keeps several layouts, comparisons and delivery packages together, ready to export and hand to collaborators.

home_findings_text.source: 总面积研究：相同面积上限下，1–6个区域各保留多少信号。历史批次保留最初的半径实验和两区域原型。
home_findings_text.en: Total-area study: how much signal 1–6 regions keep under the same area cap. The historical batches keep the original radius experiment and the two-region pilot.

channels_intro.source: 从已有记录的协方差摘要中，为给定通道数选出重建误差最小的通道子集。计算在浏览器内完成，不提交任务。
channels_intro.en: From the covariance summary of an existing recording, choose the channel subset with the smallest reconstruction error for a given number of channels. The calculation runs in the browser and submits no task.

layout_missing.source: 找不到这个布局的记录。它可能来自其他工作区，或记录已被移除。
layout_missing.en: No record of this layout was found. It may come from another workspace, or the record was removed.

layout_choose.source: 请从布局列表选择一个布局。
layout_choose.en: Choose a layout from the layout list.

layout_by_condition_text.source: 同一组坐标在不同噪声模型、电导率、头模或数据先验下的评价。名义Ernie评价排在最前；不同条件的分数只与相同条件比较。
layout_by_condition_text.en: Evaluations of the same coordinates under different noise models, conductivities, heads or data priors. The nominal Ernie evaluation comes first; scores are compared only within the same condition.

layout_ar.en: Minimum Required Retention for this layout

layout_ar_hint.source: 只更新判断，不重新计算。
layout_ar_hint.en: Updates the judgement only; nothing is recalculated.

layout_ask_text.source: 一次请求就能回答的问题在这里发起；需要多次请求的问题是稳健性研究。
layout_ask_text.en: Questions one request can answer start here; questions that need several requests are robustness studies.

layout_other_conditions.source: 在其他条件下评价 · 位置偏移测试
layout_other_conditions.en: Evaluate under other conditions · Position displacement test

layout_derived.source: 由这个布局派生的记录

library_intro.source: 每个布局一行：同一组坐标在不同条件下的评价合并显示，“查看布局”打开它的详情页。编辑副本和信号实验保留自己的协议与原布局关联。
library_intro.en: One row per layout: evaluations of the same coordinates under different conditions are shown together, and “View layout” opens its page. Edited copies and signal experiments keep their own protocols and their link to the original layout.

library_hint.source: 点击“查看布局”打开布局详情；编辑副本与信号实验的“查看结果”在本页下方展开。
library_hint.en: “View layout” opens the layout’s page; “View results” of an edited copy or a signal experiment opens below on this page.

conclusion_choose_b.source: 选择方案B后显示对比结论。
conclusion_choose_b.en: Choose design B to see the conclusion.

conclusion_choose_a.source: 选择方案A后显示对比结论。
conclusion_choose_a.en: Choose design A to see the conclusion.

conclusion_both.source: 两个方案都达到全部启用要求。
conclusion_both.en: Both designs meet all enabled requirements.

conclusion_only.source: 只有{{0}}达到全部启用要求。

conclusion_neither.source: 两个方案都未达到全部启用要求。
conclusion_neither.en: Neither design meets all enabled requirements.

conclusion_same.source: 两个方案的信号重建保留率相同。
conclusion_same.en: The two designs have the same field reconstruction retention.

conclusion_higher.source: 方案B的信号重建保留率比方案A高{{0}}个百分点。
conclusion_higher.en: Design B’s field reconstruction retention is {{0}} percentage points higher than design A’s.

conclusion_lower.source: 方案B的信号重建保留率比方案A低{{0}}个百分点。
conclusion_lower.en: Design B’s field reconstruction retention is {{0}} percentage points lower than design A’s.

conclusion_conditions.source: 两条记录的评价条件不同，差值只作参考；同一条件下的对比请在布局详情页选择相同条件。
conclusion_conditions.en: The two records were evaluated under different conditions, so the difference is only indicative; to compare under one condition, choose the same condition on the layouts’ pages.

design_next_text.source: 布局详情汇总这个布局在各条件下的评价；信号仿真对照标准64的时间波形与重建，加入模拟心电和眼电。
design_next_text.en: The layout’s page gathers its evaluations under every condition; signal simulation compares time waveforms and reconstruction with standard64, adding simulated ECG and EOG.

design_next_text_noise.source: 布局详情汇总这个布局在各条件下的评价。空间相关噪声或数据先验下搜索的布局不进入信号仿真。
design_next_text_noise.en: The layout’s page gathers its evaluations under every condition. Layouts searched under spatially correlated noise or a data prior do not enter signal simulation.

design_next_empty.source: 计算出完整64点布局后，可打开布局详情或用同一脑源测试。
design_next_empty.en: Once a complete 64-point layout is computed, open its page or test it with the same brain sources.

study_64_only.source: 稳健性研究只接受64电极布局

method_intro.source: 完整的方法说明写在项目文档中，按主题分章；本页是目录。首次操作请查看“使用指南”。
method_intro.en: The full method is written in the project documentation, one chapter per topic; this page is its index. For first steps, see the “User Guide”.

method_local.en: The documentation is served by the local service (/docs/).

method_github.source: 文档链接打开GitHub上的原文；用本机服务（eeglayoutlab）运行并构建文档后，链接改为本机的/docs/。
method_github.en: Documentation links open the text on GitHub; when the local service (eeglayoutlab) runs with the documentation built, they open /docs/ on this machine.

method_moved.en: The section “{{0}}” has moved to the documentation.

method_model_text.source: 头模、脑源、噪声、三项保留率的定义与公式、阈值与布局约束，以及分数的适用范围。
method_model_text.en: The head model, sources and noise; the definitions and formulas of the three retentions; thresholds and layout constraints; and the scope of the scores.

method_details_text.source: 信号生成、组织传播、脑源与波形、干扰、默认参数，以及每个工具（搜索、编辑、坐标评价、信号仿真）的计算方式。
method_details_text.en: Signal generation, tissue propagation, sources and waveforms, interference, default parameters, and how each tool (search, editing, coordinate evaluation, signal simulation) calculates.

method_history_text.source: 最初的半径批次与两区域原型按原协议保留；验证页列出已完成的检查与仍未完成的工作。
method_history_text.en: The original radius batch and the two-region pilot are kept under their own protocols; the validation page lists the checks done and the work still open.

method_coordinate.source: 坐标评价与位置偏移测试
method_coordinate.en: Coordinate evaluation and position displacement test

guide_purpose.source: 比较电极集中到少数区域后，相对标准全头64导的采集表现。界面分五个板块，顶栏从左到右依次排列。
guide_purpose.en: Compare how 64 electrodes gathered into a few regions record relative to the standard full-head 64-channel layout. The interface has five areas, in order from left to right in the top bar.

guide_findings.source: 先看已发表的结果：相同面积上限下，区域越少，保留的信号越少吗？比较前先核对实验协议、面积或半径约束，以及电极总数。
guide_findings.en: Start with the published results: under the same area cap, do fewer regions keep less signal? Before comparing, check the protocol, the area or radius constraint, and the electrode count.

guide_design.source: 依次选择允许布置范围、区域数量和每区半径上限，再点击计算；已有电极坐标时，直接进入坐标导入。尚未生成完整布局时，扩大半径或调整区域后重试。
guide_design.en: Choose the allowed placement range, the number of regions and the radius cap per region, then calculate; with existing electrode coordinates, go straight to coordinate import. If no complete layout is constructed, widen the radius or adjust the regions and try again.

guide_layouts.source: 布局列表每个布局一行；“查看布局”打开详情页，从那里发起评价、对比、研究、信号仿真、编辑和导出。
guide_layouts.en: The layout list has one row per layout; “View layout” opens its page, where evaluations, comparisons, studies, signal simulation, editing and export start.

guide_compare.source: 方案对比先选布局，再选评价条件；结论栏先说明两个布局是否达到要求以及相差多少，详细指标在下方。
guide_compare.en: Compare Layouts asks for a layout, then for an evaluation condition; the conclusion bar first says whether each layout meets the requirement and how far apart they are, with the detailed metrics below.

guide_reception.source: 比较同一场景下的标准64导、当前布局接收信号和重建结果。编辑后的减导记录不进入此实验。
guide_reception.en: Compare the signals received by standard64 and by the current layout, and their reconstruction, in the same scenario. Edited records with fewer channels do not enter this experiment.

guide_projects.source: 研究项目把多个布局、对比和交付包放在一起，便于导出和交给合作者。方案对比支持报告、JSON和坐标CSV导出。
guide_projects.en: A research project keeps several layouts, comparisons and delivery packages together, ready to export and hand to collaborators. Compare Layouts exports a report, JSON and coordinate CSV.

guide_intro.source: 工作区汇总最近的工作；布局板块新建和查找布局；分析板块提出问题；研究结果是已发表的实验；文档包括本指南与建模原理。
guide_intro.en: The workspace gathers recent work; Layouts creates and finds layouts; Analysis asks questions; Findings holds the published experiments; Documentation has this guide and the methods.

usage_1.source: 工作区：最近的布局、计算任务、研究和项目。布局：新建布局（区域设计、坐标导入、电极编辑）和布局列表。分析：方案对比、稳健性研究、信号仿真和通道子集。研究结果：已发表的总面积研究与历史批次。文档：本指南与建模原理。
usage_1.en: Workspace: recent layouts, computation tasks, studies and projects. Layouts: new layouts (region design, coordinate import, electrode editing) and the layout list. Analysis: Compare Layouts, robustness studies, signal simulation and channel subsets. Findings: the published total-area study and the historical batches. Documentation: this guide and the methods.

usage_2.source: 总面积研究比较相同总面积上限下1、2、3、4、6个区域各保留多少信号。选择一行查看点位与三项保留率；查看、筛选和调整AR不会启动新计算。
usage_2.en: The total-area study compares how much signal 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 regions keep under the same total-area cap. Choose a row to see its electrode positions and three retentions; viewing, filtering and changing the minimum required retention start no new calculation.

usage_3.source: 区域设计固定64点并按区域均衡分配，按每区半径上限搜索；坐标导入读取已有电极坐标并在当前条件下评价；电极编辑从已有布局删减或移动点位，另存为编辑副本。新结果自动保存，相同配置优先直接读取。
usage_3.en: Region design fixes 64 points, shares them evenly among the regions and searches under a radius cap per region; coordinate import reads existing electrode coordinates and evaluates them under the current conditions; electrode editing removes or moves points of an existing layout and saves an edited copy. New results are saved automatically, and a configuration already computed is read back.

usage_4.source: 每个布局一页：同一组坐标在不同噪声模型、电导率、头模或数据先验下的评价排成一张表，名义Ernie评价在前。不同条件的分数只与相同条件比较。
usage_4.en: Each layout has one page: evaluations of the same coordinates under different noise models, conductivities, heads or data priors form one table, the nominal Ernie evaluation first. Scores are compared only within the same condition.

usage_5_title.source: 5. 一个问题，一次操作或一项研究
usage_5_title.en: 5. One question: an action or a study

usage_5.source: 一次请求就能回答的问题是一个操作：在其他条件下评价、位置偏移测试、与另一个布局对比。需要多次请求的问题是稳健性研究：按随机种子、头模或网格位移重复评价并汇总。
usage_5.en: A question one request can answer is an action: an evaluation under other conditions, a position displacement test, a comparison with another layout. A question that needs several requests is a robustness study: evaluations repeated over random seeds, heads or grid displacements and summarized together.

usage_6.source: 先选一个完整的64点布局，再设置脑源位置、波形和模拟干扰。布局坐标固定；此页比较所选场景下标准64导与当前布局的接收波形和信号重建。只有独立噪声下得到的布局进入信号仿真。
usage_6.en: Choose a complete 64-point layout, then set the source location, waveform and simulated interference. The coordinates stay fixed; the page compares the waveforms received by standard64 and by the current layout, and their reconstruction, in the chosen scenario. Only layouts obtained under independent noise enter signal simulation.

usage_7_title.en: 7. The three retentions and the minimum requirement

usage_7.source: 与同一协议下的标准全头64导比较。信号重建保留率衡量恢复全头信号的能力；幅度保留率（最差10%）取相对损失最大的10%源面积权重的幅度比；相对定位评分由误差换算。默认三项都要达到同一最低要求AR；修改AR只重新判断已有数值，不改变点位、不重新计算。
usage_7.en: Each is compared with the standard full-head 64-channel layout under the same protocol. Field reconstruction retention measures how well the full-head signal is recovered; amplitude retention (worst 10%) is the amplitude ratio over the 10% of source area with the largest relative loss; the relative localization score is derived from the error. By default all three must reach the same minimum required retention; changing it only re-judges existing values and neither moves points nor recalculates.

findings_batches_intro.source: 两个早期批次按各自协议保留，只读查看；它们的分数只评价各自的布局，不与本页结果混合。
findings_batches_intro.en: Two early batches are kept under their own protocols, read-only. Their scores qualify only their own layouts and are not mixed with the results on this page.

findings_radius_protocol.source: 每区半径上限，区域允许相交 · 单Ernie头模
findings_radius_protocol.en: Radius cap per region, regions may overlap · Ernie head only

findings_pilot_protocol.source: 两个32电极区域按几何规则构造，未做优化 · 单Ernie头模
findings_pilot_protocol.en: Two regions of 32 electrodes built by geometric rules, not optimized · Ernie head only
